title: Grandma Reads in the Bath With Kitchen Tongs 📚 | Verdict Picks Toon Ep.5 #Shorts
description:
Grandma June reads every night by Grandpa's old fishing headlamp, and in the bath with a freezer bag and kitchen tongs.
Jo has a better gift idea.

Verdict Picks Toon, Episode 5. Our full e-reader guide (Kindle vs Paperwhite vs Colorsoft vs Kobo), with ads, library books, three-year costs and Black Friday price lines:

thumb.art: Comic scene in an old-fashioned bathroom. The top 40 percent of the image is only a plain soft-lavender tiled wall. Below that: June sits in a clawfoot tub full of bubbles up to her shoulders, a floral shower cap on and an oversized old fishing headlamp strapped over it beaming, proudly holding a paperback sealed in a plastic freezer bag with long kitchen tongs; in the doorway at one side Jo, in a teal cardigan, holds a small wrapped gift and laughs with a hand over her mouth. Warm steamy light, bold colors, funny and loving.
